founded_year.quote: SIX has stood for innovation and stability on the global financial markets since 2008. Our strength is founded on our history: SIX was formed from the merger of experienced financial companies – with their beginnings going back to around 1930.

history.zh: 2008年由SWX集团、SIS集团、Telekurs集团合并组建现SIX Group；2020年并购西班牙交易所集团BME（Bolsas y Mercados Españoles），现同时运营瑞士与西班牙两国证券交易所业务
history.en: Formed in 2008 through the merger of the SWX Group, SIS Group and Telekurs Group into the current SIX Group; acquired the Spanish exchange group BME (Bolsas y Mercados Españoles) in 2020 and now operates stock exchange businesses in both Switzerland and Spain
history.detail: 2008年三方合并的具体名称组合与2020年BME并购，均为第三方综述与本所官网新闻稿多处提及的常见表述，本次未逐条抓取合并/并购交易的原始公告文本核实细节（如交易金额、完成日期），confidence 相应标 medium。

regulator.zh: 瑞士金融市场监管局（FINMA）——终局监管权；另有瑞士国家银行（SNB）对系统重要性基础设施（含SIX x-clear）的监测
regulator.en: Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) — ultimate supervisory authority; the Swiss National Bank (SNB) additionally monitors systemically important infrastructure (including SIX x-clear)
regulator.detail:
监管为三层结构：(1) SNB监测系统重要性法人实体（SIC、SECOM、SIX x-clear）；(2) FINMA对
从事证券交易与结算的全部SIX实体行使直接监管；(3) 自律监管由SIX Exchange Regulation
（见self_regulatory_org）承担。三层并存、职责不同，不是单一监管机构的简单对照。
regulator.quote: All entities of SIX that are engaged in securities trading and securities settlement are subject to the direct supervision of FINMA. ... The legal framework is provided by the Federal Act on Financial Market Infrastructures and Market Conduct in Securities and Derivatives Trading (FinMIA). Ultimate supervisory authority lies with the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA).

self_regulatory_org.zh: SIX Exchange Regulation（SER）——依《证券交易法》自律监管授权设立的独立实体，与SIX集团运营业务分离，直接向SIX董事会主席报告
self_regulatory_org.en: SIX Exchange Regulation (SER) — an independent entity established under the self-regulatory mandate of the Stock Exchange Act, segregated from SIX's operational business and reporting directly to the Chairman of the Board of Directors of SIX
self_regulatory_org.detail: SER法律上是独立法人（SIX Exchange Regulation AG，ser-ag.com为其独立域名），下设Regulatory Board（制定规则）、Surveillance & Enforcement（监督参与者/交易员）、Listing & Enforcement（监督发行人）、Sanction Commission/Appeals Board/Board of Arbitration（裁决），职权三分。

sources.title: We regulate the swiss stock exchange（SER官网关于页）

self_regulatory_org.quote: On the basis of the self-regulatory mandate prescribed under the Stock Exchange Act, SIX performs regulatory functions in stock market trading and the admission of securities as well as associated follow-up obligations. The Exchange Regulation entity is segregated from the operational business of SIX and reports directly to the Chairman of the Board of Directors of SIX.

clearing_regulator.zh: 瑞士金融市场监管局（FINMA）——SIX x-clear（中央对手方）与SIX SIS（中央证券存管机构）均持有FINMA依《金融市场基础设施法》（FMIA）颁发的牌照
clearing_regulator.en: Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) — both SIX x-clear (CCP) and SIX SIS (CSD) hold licences issued by FINMA under the Financial Market Infrastructure Act (FMIA)
clearing_regulator.quote: SIX x-clear is licensed by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) as a central counterparty according to the Swiss Financial Market Infrastructure Act (FMIA). SIX SIS possesses a license as central security depository under FMIA.

core_laws.zh: 《联邦金融市场基础设施与证券衍生品交易市场行为法》（FinMIA/FMIA）
core_laws.en: Federal Act on Financial Market Infrastructures and Market Conduct in Securities and Derivatives Trading (FinMIA / FMIA)
core_laws.detail:
瑞士不是欧盟成员国，FinMIA是本国独立立法（2015年6月19日通过），不是MiFID II的国内转化法。
本所《交易规则》（Trading Rules）§26明确：规则以德/法/英三种语言发布，三者不一致时以
德文本为准——这一点与Eurex（Deutsche Börse Group旗下、同样以德文Börsenordnung为终局
文本）构成同类对照，但SIX的适用法律体系（瑞士FinMIA）与Eurex（德国《交易所法》
Börsengesetz）是两套不同的国家法律，不要混同。

core_laws.quote: The Trading Rules, including the implementing provisions of the Exchange, are available in German, French and English. sources.title: Trading Guide — Business Day Overview

matching_principle.zh: 价格-时间优先原则：更优价格（买方最高限价、卖方最低限价）优先成交，不限价申报优先于限价申报，同价按接收先后顺序成交；集合竞价另按「最大可执行数量原则」确定单一成交价
matching_principle.en: Price-time priority: the order/quote with the better price (highest limit for buy side, lowest for sell side) is executed first, unlimited orders enjoy top priority, and orders at the same price are executed in order of receipt; auctions additionally apply the "principle of highest executable volume" to determine a single auction price
matching_principle.quote: As a rule, the price-time priority principle applies. This means that the order and quote with the better price (highest price limit for buy side, lowest price limit for sell side) is executed first. Unlimited orders enjoy top priority when consolidating orders and quotes.

sources.title: Directive 3 — Trading §6 Execution priority

order_types.zh: Normal order（普通订单，限价/不限价）；Iceberg order（冰山订单，逐笔披露可见数量）；Retail order（零售触发订单，含Stop Limit/Stop Loss两类，触发前不进入订单簿）；Auction Volume Discovery order（集合竞价隐藏订单，仅用于开/收盘竞价按数量-时间优先撮合）
order_types.en: Normal order (limited or unlimited price); Iceberg order (discloses only a visible tranche at a time); Retail order (trigger-based, not visible pre-trigger, with Stop Limit / Stop Loss variants); Auction Volume Discovery order (hidden order used only in opening/closing auctions, matched under quantity-time priority)
order_types.quote: The Exchange supports the order types: a) Normal order; ... b) Iceberg order; ... c) Retail order; ... d) Auction Volume Discovery order

sources.title: Directive 3 — Trading §5.1.2 Order types

tick_size.zh: 按价格区间与流动性带（Band A-F，依近90日日均成交笔数ANT分类）双维度分档：同一价格区间内流动性越高、最小报价单位越小，如价格1-2瑞郎档，Band A（低流动性）为0.01，Band F（高流动性）低至0.0002
tick_size.en: Tiered by both price range and a liquidity band (Band A-F, classified by average number of trades — ANT); within the same price range, higher liquidity means a smaller tick, e.g. for the CHF 1-2 price band, Band A (low liquidity) is 0.01 while Band F (high liquidity) is as small as 0.0002

sources.title: Directive 3 — Trading, Annex D Price Steps (Tick Size)

board_lot_size.zh: 未见最低整手（lot size）要求；订单以证券数量为单位申报，以单股为最小可交易单位
board_lot_size.en: No minimum board-lot requirement found; orders are specified by number of securities, with a single share as the smallest tradable unit
board_lot_size.detail: 推断依据：Directive 3 §5.1.3订单规范（Order volume: number of securities or nominal value for percent-listed instruments）未设最低股数门槛，是从条文「未设限」这一消极事实推出，非官方正面声明「无最低整手」，故confidence标medium而非high。

odd_lot_handling.detail: 既然未见整手/碎股概念区分（见board_lot_size），本字段的设计前提可能对本所不完全适用，留空，不强行套用，见OPEN-QUESTIONS。

type.zh: 动态参考价区间——预期后续成交价偏离当前参考价超出阈值即触发交易中断（Trading Interruption），而非直接禁止申报的固定涨跌停
type.en: Dynamic reference-price range — trading is interrupted once the potential subsequent execution price deviates from the current reference price beyond a threshold, rather than orders being flatly barred by a fixed daily limit

sources.title: "Trading Parameters" Guideline, Annex A – Blue Chip Shares §4 Trading interruption

type.quote: Continuous trading shall be interrupted for 5 minutes if the potential subsequent price differs a) by 1.5% or more from the current reference price; b) by 1.5% or more from a reference price valid within 10 seconds (Avalanche Stop).

main_board.zh: 蓝筹股（Annex A）：偏离参考价±1.5%触发5分钟交易中断（另有10秒内价格骤变的Avalanche Stop机制，同阈值）
main_board.en: Blue Chip Shares (Annex A): a ±1.5% deviation from the reference price triggers a 5-minute trading interruption (an Avalanche Stop for rapid moves within 10 seconds applies the same threshold)
main_board.quote: Continuous trading shall be interrupted for 5 minutes if the potential subsequent price differs a) by 1.5% or more from the current reference price; b) by 1.5% or more from a reference price valid within 10 seconds (Avalanche Stop).

other_boards.zh: 中小盘股（Annex B）：一般个股±2%触发15分钟中断；SMIM成份股±2%触发5分钟中断；被标记为「volatile securities」的个股阈值放宽至±10%（触发5分钟中断）。开盘/收盘集合竞价另设「Delayed Auction」延时机制，计算价偏离参考价±2%~5%（按细分市场而异）即延长竞价时段5-15分钟
other_boards.en: Mid-/Small-Cap Shares (Annex B): ±2% triggers a 15-minute interruption for ordinary constituents; ±2% triggers a 5-minute interruption for SMIM constituents; securities classified as "volatile securities" have a widened ±10% threshold (5-minute interruption). Opening/closing auctions separately have a "Delayed Auction" mechanism extending the auction by 5-15 minutes (varying by segment) if the calculated price deviates ±2%-5% from the reference price
other_boards.quote: For securities of the Swiss Market Index Mid (SMIM®), the delay in the opening or the trading interruption shall be 5 minutes and the bandwidth shall be 2% or more ... For volatile securities, the delay in the opening or the trading interruption shall be 5 minutes and the bandwidth shall be 10% or more

circuit_breaker.zh: 无独立于个股级波动性中断之外、按指数跌幅自动触发的全市场熔断；极端情形下交易所依《交易规则》「非常规情形」/「紧急情形」条款拥有自由裁量权，可延迟开盘、限制/暂停个股连续交易、拒绝或删除订单，乃至暂停部分规则
circuit_breaker.en: No automatic market-wide circuit breaker triggered by index-level declines, separate from the per-security Volatility Interruption; in extreme situations the Exchange has discretionary powers under the Trading Rules' "Extraordinary situations" / "Emergency situations" provisions to delay openings, restrict or suspend continuous trading in a security, reject or delete orders, or even suspend rules in part
circuit_breaker.detail: 与Eurex/JPX的情况相似（均未找到独立于个股价格机制之外的自动全市场熔断），可能是本次检索范围局限，未逐条核实是否存在，见OPEN-QUESTIONS。

sources.title: Trading Rules §10.10.1/10.10.2 Extraordinary/Emergency situations

circuit_breaker.quote: In order to ensure proper trading, should an extraordinary situation arise, the Exchange may institute all the measures which it deems necessary to maintain fair, efficient and orderly trading.

volatility_interruption.zh: 见price_limits——本所以「Trading Interruption」（交易中断）统一处理开盘延时与盘中波动，按细分市场设不同带宽（蓝筹股±1.5%/5分钟，中小盘股±2%/15分钟或5分钟，波动股±10%/5分钟），交易所可按短期通知调整参数
volatility_interruption.en: See price_limits — the Exchange uses a unified "Trading Interruption" mechanism for both delayed openings and intraday volatility, with bandwidths varying by segment (Blue Chip ±1.5%/5min; Mid-/Small-Cap ±2%/15min or 5min; volatile securities ±10%/5min); the Exchange may adjust these parameters at short notice
volatility_interruption.quote: Continuous trading shall be interrupted for 5 minutes if the potential subsequent price differs a) by 1.5% or more from the current reference price ... Continuous trading shall be interrupted for 15 minutes if the potential subsequent price differs a) by 2% or more ... the delay in the opening or the trading interruption shall be 5 minutes and the bandwidth shall be 10% or more

sources.title: "Trading Parameters" Guideline

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 交易中断后，交易所以「随机结束时间30秒内」重新开盘（集合竞价方式恢复交易）
trading_halt_mechanism.en: After a trading interruption, the Exchange reopens trading via an auction with a random end within 30 seconds
trading_halt_mechanism.quote: The Exchange shall open trading after a trading interruption with a random end within 30 seconds.

sources.title: "Trading Parameters" Guideline

intraday_reversal.detail: 本所结算周期为T+2（见clearing.settlement_cycle），但「当日买入当日可否卖出」这类回转交易限制本质是结算/借券层面的问题，本次未找到官方原文对此有专门表述（欧洲主流市场普遍无此限制，但未核实原文，不采信常识），留空，见OPEN-QUESTIONS。

short_selling.zh: 允许卖空，无需事先借券锁定；卖方须在成交时点即完成结算安排（与交收责任一致）；非常规情形下交易所经与FINMA协商可另行发布卖空限制规定
short_selling.en: Short selling is permitted without a pre-borrow requirement; the seller must be able to settle the short sale by the time of trade execution; in special situations the Exchange may, after consultation with FINMA, issue additional short-selling restrictions
short_selling.detail: 与上交所/深交所式「限指定标的范围」的融资融券制度不同，瑞士本身没有专门的卖空立法（WebSearch确认：'no provisions to regulate short selling in terms of laws'），卖空规则完全由交易所自律规则承载，是与本项目其他市场结构性不同的一点。

sources.title: Directive 3 — Trading, VI Short-selling §25/26

short_selling.quote: The short-selling of securities traded on SIX Swiss Exchange AG is permitted. ... The seller must settle the short sale at the latest upon execution of the trade in accordance with Clause 15.1 Trading Rules. ... In special situations the Management Committee of the Exchange may issue regulations on short-selling.

block_trade.detail: 「大宗交易」在本所对应概念可能是Off-order-book trades（场外成交报备）或SwissAtMid机制下的大额订单，但本次未找到官方对「大宗交易」专门量化门槛（如最低金额）的原文表述，留空，见dark_pool字段的相关说明。

dark_pool.zh: SwissAtMid——不含盘前透明度的中点撮合交易服务，依瑞士《金融市场基础设施条例》（FMIO）第27条第4款相关豁免运作，最高订单价值CHF 250,000,000
dark_pool.en: SwissAtMid — a mid-point matching trading service exempted from pre-trade transparency, operating under the relevant exemptions of Art. 27 para. 4 FMIO; maximum order value CHF 250,000,000
dark_pool.quote: Iceberg orders, Retail orders and orders with at-the-close validity (namely also Auction Volume Discovery orders) which are executed using an order management facility of the Exchange are exempted from pre-trade transparency regulations according to Art. 27 para. 4 lit. c FMIO.

sources.title: Directive 3 — Trading §11 Exemptions from pre-trade transparency

market_maker_scheme.zh: 做市商须与交易所签订书面「Market Maker Agreement」；具体按细分市场设定报价覆盖率与最大点差要求，如蓝筹股要求月均80%以上交易时段内维持不超过2.5%（或部分品种5%）的最大点差
market_maker_scheme.en: Market makers must sign a written "Market Maker Agreement" with the Exchange; coverage and maximum-spread requirements vary by segment, e.g. Blue Chip Shares require quoting over 80% of trading hours (monthly average) with a maximum spread of 2.5% (or 5% for certain instruments)
market_maker_scheme.quote: The Exchange may admit a participant as a market maker under a written agreement (Market Maker Agreement). ... The market maker contractually undertakes to meet the following requirements over 80% (on a monthly average) ... with a maximum trading spread of 2.5%; or ... prices with a maximum trading spread of 5%.

sources.title: Directive 1: Admission of participants §4
"Trading Parameters" Guideline, Annex A

connect_schemes.detail: SIX Group同时运营本所与西班牙BME Exchange（见overview.history），但本次未找到两地市场之间存在类似「沪港通」式互联互通订单路由机制的官方原文——目前更像是「同集团分别运营两个独立市场」而非「互联互通」，该关系已通过group_id表达，不在本字段重复，留空，见OPEN-QUESTIONS。

boards.target_companies: 适用IFRS或US GAAP财务报告准则的发行人，是本所股票主流监管标准
适用Swiss GAAP FER财务报告准则（瑞士银行法下的报告准则）的发行人
面向中小企业（SME）的成长板块

review_system.zh: 披露为本：Regulatory Board依提交文件审核上市申请是否满足《上市规则》要求，符合即予批准（可附加条件），上市本身不构成对证券或发行人的价值判断；无需FINMA另行批准
review_system.en: Disclosure-based: the Regulatory Board reviews listing applications against the requirements of the Listing Rules and approves (possibly with conditions) if met; listing itself is not a value judgment on the securities or issuer. No additional FINMA approval required
review_system.detail: 交易所自身审核、非政府预先审批，属 ADR-023 重新划分后的 `disclosure_with_discretion` 类。第三方法律实务资源（Baker McKenzie）确认「无需FINMA另行批准」，与本所官方LR原文'Regulatory Board审核+批准'的两步流程一致，佐证性引用，confidence标medium的部分留在下方来源列表第二条。

sources.title: Listing Rules Art. 46/47（审核与决定条款）

review_system.quote: Art. 46 Review of listing application: The Regulatory Board will review the listing application on the basis of the documents that have been submitted. Art. 47 Decision: The Regulatory Board will approve the listing application if it fulfils the requirements laid down in these Listing Rules. ... Listing does not constitute a value judgement about the securities or about the issuer.

sources.title: Listing Rules（LR，2024年11月6日版，SER官网英文版PDF）

transfer_between_boards.detail: Listing Rules提及可「重新分配到不同监管标准」（reallocation to a different regulatory standard，见delisting_conditions同条上下文），但具体转板流程未逐条核实，留空。

sources.title: Listing Rules（LR，2024年11月6日版，SER官网英文版PDF）

continuing_obligations.zh: 发行人须按所适用财务报告准则（IFRS/US GAAP/Swiss GAAP FER等）发布经审计年度报告；Regulatory Board可要求补充公司治理结构与运作方式等信息
continuing_obligations.en: Issuers must publish an audited annual report under their applicable financial reporting standard (IFRS/US GAAP/Swiss GAAP FER etc.); the Regulatory Board may require additional disclosure on corporate management and governance structure
continuing_obligations.quote: The issuer is required to publish an annual report. This comprises the audited annual financial statements, in accordance with the applicable financial reporting standard, as well as the corresponding audit report.

sources.title: Listing Rules Art. 49 Annual reporting

suspension_resumption.zh: SIX Exchange Regulation可依发行人申请或依职权，在异常情形（尤其是发行人违反重大披露义务）下临时暂停交易
suspension_resumption.en: SIX Exchange Regulation may temporarily suspend trading, either at the issuer's request or on its own initiative, where unusual circumstances — in particular a breach of material disclosure obligations by the issuer — make suspension advisable
suspension_resumption.quote: SIX Exchange Regulation may temporarily suspend the trading of securities at the request of the issuer or on its own initiative if unusual circumstances, specifically the breach of important disclosure obligations by the issuer, indicate that such a suspension is advisable.

sources.title: Listing Rules Art. 57 Suspension of trading

delisting_conditions.zh: 五类情形：(1)发行人依合理申请主动退市；(2)偿付能力存在重大疑虑或已进入破产/清算程序；(3)Regulatory Board认定证券市场流动性已不足；(4)连续停牌三个月且暂停原因持续存在；(5)不再满足上市要求
delisting_conditions.en: Five categories: (1) a justified application by the issuer; (2) serious doubt over solvency, or insolvency/liquidation proceedings already commenced; (3) the Regulatory Board deeming the market no longer sufficiently liquid; (4) trading suspended continuously for three months with the reasons persisting; (5) listing requirements no longer fulfilled
delisting_conditions.quote: The Regulatory Board may cancel the listing of securities in the following cases: 1. following a justified application by an issuer...; 2. if the solvency of the issuer is in serious doubt, or insolvency or liquidation proceedings have already commenced...; 3. if the Regulatory Board deems that there is no longer a sufficiently liquid market in the securities; 4. if trading has been suspended for a continuous three-month period, and the reasons for the suspension continue to exist; 5. if the listing requirements set out in Art. 26 are no longer fulfilled.

sources.title: Listing Rules Art. 58 Delisting

delisting_process.zh: 主动退市须发行人负责机构签署书面同意声明；Regulatory Board可对退市附加通知期与合理等待期要求，审查退市决定是否符合公司法定程序（尤其涉及2023年起生效的新规——股东大会而非董事会才有权决定主动退市）
delisting_process.en: A voluntary delisting requires a signed declaration from the issuer's responsible bodies consenting to it; the Regulatory Board may make delisting conditional on due notice and appropriate waiting periods, and reviews whether the delisting decision was duly taken under corporate law (notably, since a 2023 legal reform it is the shareholders' meeting rather than the board of directors that has the power to decide on delisting)
delisting_process.detail: 2023年起生效的「股东大会而非董事会决定退市」这一变化，来自WebSearch定位到的第三方法律资源（CapLaw等），本次未逐条抓取原始瑞士债法典（OR）条文核实，confidence标medium。

sources.title: Listing Rules Art. 58

delisting_transition_period.detail: LR Art.58仅笼统要求「适当的通知与等待期」，未见统一的具体天数/交易日数规定（不同案例可能不同），本次未找到官方原文给出统一标准，留空。

items.review_frequency: 每年9月第3个周五进行年度定期审核（另设3月31日/9月30日/12月31日三个临时选样候补名单截止日）
items.description: 本所蓝筹旗舰指数，成份为本所交易的20只最大、流动性最好的股票，覆盖全市场自由流通市值75%以上，设权重上限（capping factor）以满足UCITS基金分散度要求
流动性较好个股的广泛基准指数，是SMI等大多数派生指数的选样母指数（index universe）

items.review_frequency: 连续动态审核（符合入选标准即随时纳入，不符合即随时剔除，非固定周期审核）
items.description: 覆盖面最广的指数，成份为本所主板与Sparks板全部本土及外国股票

settlement_cycle.en: T+2 (the second exchange day following execution)
settlement_cycle.quote: Stock exchange transactions in securities listed or authorized for trading on SIX Swiss Exchange are as a general rule settled on the second exchange day (T+2) following execution.

sources.title: Clearing and Settlement Provisions for Trading Participants

ccp_name.detail: 《交易规则》本身对CCP采用中性表述「recognised central counterparty」，允许存在多家受认可的中央对手方（欧洲CCP互操作性安排下），SIX x-clear是本所所属集团旗下的默认/主要CCP，非本所条文规定的唯一法定CCP，此处填写的是集团内该实体名称。

sources.title: Monitoring and Regulation

ccp_name.quote: SIX x-clear is licensed by the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) as a central counterparty according to the Swiss Financial Market Infrastructure Act (FMIA).

csd_name.detail: SIX SIS同时承担瑞士本国中央证券存管机构（CSD）与国际中央证券存管机构（ICSD）职能，运营SECOM实时结算系统；非瑞郎证券可另经Euroclear Bank / Clearstream Luxembourg结算。

sources.title: About SIX SIS AG

csd_name.quote: SIX SIS possesses a license as central security depository under FMIA.

delivery_method.zh: 不适用（本所记录的是现货证券市场；衍生品合约的交割方式在本所体系外，属另行运营的相关衍生品市场）
delivery_method.en: N/A (this record covers the cash securities market; derivatives delivery mechanics fall outside this entity)
delivery_method.detail: 推断依据：products章节所列品类均为现货证券（股票/基金/债券/结构性产品/ETP等），Trading Rules正文未见对「交割」（delivery）作为衍生品到期履约概念的规定，与cn-sse/hk-hkex/us-nyse/jp-jpx四家现货标杆的处理一致。

sources.title: Trading Rules（SIX Exchange Regulation官网英文版PDF，通篇未见衍生品式"交割"条款，佐证本所为现货市场）
Directive 1: Admission of participants

account_opening_requirements.zh: 参与者须持有FINMA颁发的证券商牌照或「远程会员」（remote member）授权；具备接入交易系统的技术条件；是受认可清算机构与结算机构的参与者（或通过General Clearing Member/托管行间接接入）
account_opening_requirements.en: Applicants must hold a FINMA licence as a securities firm or FINMA authorisation as a remote member; meet the technical requirements for connecting to the exchange system; and be a participant in a recognised clearing organisation and settlement organisation (directly or via a General Clearing Member / custodian)
account_opening_requirements.quote: An applicant must fulfil the admission requirements according to Clause 3 Trading Rules, i.e. he must a) have a licence as a securities firm or remote member of the Exchange from FINMA; ... d) be a participant in a clearing organisation recognised by the Exchange or have access to such via a General Clearing Member; and e) be a participant in a settlement organisation recognised by the Exchange or have access to such via a custodian.

sources.title: Directive 1: Admission of participants
Directive 1: Admission of participants

foreign_access_channel.en: "Remote Member" regime — foreign securities firms may become direct trading participants upon FINMA authorisation, without establishing a Swiss entity

dividend_withholding_tax.zh: 联邦预扣税（Verrechnungssteuer/anticipatory tax）：投资收益（含股息）35%，人寿年金/养老金15%，其他保险给付8%；由境内债务人（如支付股息的公司/托管银行）代扣代缴，本国纳税人可通过申报全额抵扣/退还，非居民可按税收协定申请部分退还
dividend_withholding_tax.en: Federal anticipatory tax (Verrechnungssteuer): 35% on investment income (including dividends), 15% on life annuities/pensions, 8% on other insurance benefits; withheld at source by the domestic debtor (e.g. the paying company/custodian bank); resident taxpayers can reclaim the full amount by declaring it, non-residents can reclaim part under applicable tax treaties
dividend_withholding_tax.quote: The tax rate is 35% for investment income and lottery winnings 15% for life annuities and pensions 8% for other insurance benefits

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: 瑞士作为非欧盟国家，其交易所监管框架能否获欧盟MiFID II/MiFIR「等效性」认定存在政治不确定性，且已实际发生过一次认定失效。时间线：(1) 欧盟委员会《实施决定》(EU) 2017/2441（2017年12月21日通过）首次认定SIX Swiss Exchange AG与BX Swiss AG符合等效标准，有效期至2018年12月31日；(2) 《实施决定》(EU) 2018/2047（2018年12月20日通过）将认定延长至2019年6月30日；(3) 此后欧盟未再续期，等效认定自2019年7月1日起失效；(4) 瑞士随即针对欧盟启动「交易所基础设施保护措施」反制（禁止外国交易场所未经认可交易瑞士股票），该措施已于2024年1月1日转入《金融市场基础设施法》（FinMIA）正式立法；(5) 随欧盟2024年修订相关法律基础，瑞士联邦委员会2025年1月29日决定，自2025年5月1日起将欧盟从保护措施适用名单中移除。截至本次核实（2026年8月），欧盟层面的正式「等效性」认定本身尚未恢复，双方仅通过瑞士单方面解除反制措施使市场准入恢复常态。
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: As a non-EU country, whether Switzerland's exchange regulatory framework retains MiFID II/MiFIR "equivalence" recognition has been a source of political uncertainty, and equivalence has in fact already lapsed once. Timeline: (1) Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2017/2441 (adopted 21 December 2017) first recognised SIX Swiss Exchange AG and BX Swiss AG as equivalent, expiring 31 December 2018; (2) Implementing Decision (EU) 2018/2047 (adopted 20 December 2018) extended recognition to 30 June 2019; (3) the EU did not renew it thereafter, and equivalence lapsed with effect from 1 July 2019; (4) Switzerland responded by activating a "stock exchange infrastructure protective measure" against the EU (barring unrecognised foreign trading venues from trading Swiss shares), which was incorporated into ordinary law (the Financial Market Infrastructure Act, FinMIA) on 1 January 2024; (5) following an EU revision of the underlying legal basis in 2024, the Swiss Federal Council decided on 29 January 2025 to remove the EU from the list of jurisdictions subject to the protective measure, effective 1 May 2025. As of this review (August 2026), formal EU-level "equivalence" recognition itself has not been reinstated — market access has instead normalised only through Switzerland's unilateral withdrawal of its countermeasure.
regulatory_change_risk_note.detail: 2026-08-21 已用欧盟官方Implementing Decision原文（eur-lex.europa.eu）与瑞士联邦财政部国际金融事务秘书处（SIF）官方说明页逐条核实完整时间线，替换掉此前仅第三方律所转述、且把第一次决定的到期日期误记为「2017年12月31日」（实际为2018年12月31日）的旧版本。欧盟官方新闻稿页面（europa.eu/rapid）本身仍为纯JS渲染SPA无法抓取；`admin.ch`两条联邦委员会新闻稿页面本次curl返回403（反爬），但SIF说明页本身已完整转述其内容，不影响本条结论。
